abstracts.abstract: AN ACT TO AMEND THE SOUTH CAROLINA CODE OF LAWS BY AMENDING SECTIONS 8-11-150 AND 8-11-155, BOTH RELATING TO PAID PARENTAL LEAVE, SO AS TO AMEND THE DEFINITION OF "ELIGIBLE STATE EMPLOYEE" AND TO INCREASE CERTAIN PAID PARENTAL LEAVE. - RATIFIED TITLE

bill.title: Paid Family Leave Eligible State Employee

posted_text:
🗓️ SC S 11 — State Employees Can Now Take Up to 6 Weeks of Paid Leave

Starting January 1, eligible state employees can now take up to six weeks of paid leave following the birth of a child or fostering a child in state custody – a key change to the definition of ‘eligible state employee’.

July 1, 2026: Effective date 10/01/26.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess126_2025-2026/bills/11.htm
